meta.title: How it works — Agental Talents
meta.description: From creating your profile to receiving your fee: how Agental represents you and works for you, step by step.

hero.title: How Agental works, for artists
hero.subtitle: A real agent who represents you, an AI working for you continuously. Here's the journey, jargon-free.

sections.title: A profile that reflects you
sections.body: You add your identity, physique, media, specialties and availability. Every industry field is explained in plain language — no need to know casting vocabulary.

sections.title: The contract that gets you represented
sections.body: You sign your representation mandate: the standard contract between an artist and their agent, governed by French law. Free, no commitment on your side, cancellable anytime.

sections.title: A watch that never stops
sections.body: The AI monitors castings 24/7 and spots the ones that truly match you. No more irrelevant listings: we find the roles that fit.

sections.title: The studio that builds your confidence
sections.body: The Self-tape Studio guides you on framing, lighting and sound, with a vocal coach. Even shot on a phone, your self-tape can change everything.

sections.title: From selection to fee
sections.body: When you're picked, we negotiate, secure the contract and pay you your fee. Your commission drops as you rise.

meta.title: FAQ — Agental Talents
meta.description: Your questions about Agental: the agency, the mandate, the commission and how it works day to day.

hero.title: Artists' frequently asked questions
hero.subtitle: Everything you want to know before getting started. Another question? Write to us.

items.a: A real, regulated artist agency whose entire operational work — scouting, applications, follow-up, coaching — is augmented by AI. We represent you; the AI works for you 24/7.

items.q: Is it a real agency or a listings platform?
items.a: A real agency: written mandate, official registration, professional liability. Not a listings site where you apply on your own.

items.q: How much does it cost to start?
items.a: Nothing. The representation mandate is free and the Free plan lets you be represented without paying. The paid subscription is optional.

items.q: Do I need experience to sign up?
items.a: No. Agental is precisely for the profiles underserved by traditional agencies. A reel filmed on your phone is enough to start.
It's the standard contract between an artist and their agent, governed by French law. It authorises us to represent you and negotiate for you. Free, no commitment on your side.

items.q: How much commission does Agental take?
items.a: 10% on Free and Pro, 7.5% on Premium, 5% on Ultimate. The more you rise, the more you keep.

items.q: Is the commission on top of the subscription?
items.a: The mandate (free) and its possible commission are separate from the subscription (optional). The subscription funds tech services; it never buys access to opportunities.
Yes, with a short notice and without having to justify it. You stay free.

items.q: How does the AI find roles for me?
items.a: It cross-references your profile (physique, specialties, languages, accents, availability) with open castings and suggests the ones that truly match.

items.q: Do I keep control of my applications?
items.a: Yes. You set your preferences (project types, mobility, caps) and can approve or decline. The AI suggests, you decide.

items.q: Does the subscription give me privileged access to castings?
items.a: No. Opportunities go through the mandate, which is free. The subscription unlocks tools (auto-application, coaching), not a fast pass.

items.q: What happens if I stop paying?
items.a: You automatically move back to the free plan. You remain represented.

items.q: Does it work on a basic phone?
items.a: Yes. The Self-tape Studio has a degraded mode designed for modest devices and slow connections.

meta.title: About us — Agental
meta.description: An idea born at the dinner table: democratising access to artistic representation through a real agent augmented by AI.

hero.title: An idea born at the table
hero.subtitle: Agental was born from a simple conviction: talent is everywhere, representation is not. We wanted to change that.

story: Too many wonderful profiles never had access to an agent: too young, too far from big cities, too 'atypical' for established agencies. Yet castings are looking for them.
We built an agency that does a real agent's work — mandate, negotiation, career defence — but whose watch, scoring and follow-up run 24/7 thanks to AI. The warmth of an agent, the power of software.

values.title: Democratise
values.body: Give access to representation to underserved profiles, without jargon or intimidating contracts.

values.title: Transparency
values.body: We always explain why. The AI is an assistant in service of humans, never a black box.

values.title: Respect
values.body: Your media stay yours. Your data is protected. So is your freedom to leave.
